name: Dialog Group Berhad
summary: Dialog Group Berhad, an investment holding company, provides technical services to the energy sector in Malaysia, Thailand, rest of Asia, Australia, New Zealand, and internationally. The company offers engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning; specialist technical; tankage piping construction; plant turnaround and specialist maintenance works; plant maintenance and catalyst handling; general civil and mechanical engineering works; specialized electrical and instrumentation and calibration; management, consultancy, and administration; project management and upstream support; process material handling; heavy fabrication and multi-disciplined engineering; power pylon painting; …
